{{Quote|I'm Captain Kaydine &ndash; Naboo's most decorated starfighter pilot, president of the Flying Color Guard, the Chancellor-elect of the Naboo Betterment Society, and all-around local celebrity!|Captain Kaydine|<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>}}
'''Kaydine''' was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps/Legends|Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. He was [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] most decorated [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], [[President/Legends|president]] of the [[Flying Color Guard]], the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chamcellor]]-elect of the [[Naboo Betterment Society]] and an all-round local celebrity. From [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Palace]], he set a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] a number of tasks combating the [[Ay'Nat]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].
